text:
Recovery Room is always a great place to go, especially when I was dealing with my shoulder injury. I train hard almost every day, so recovery is just as important as performance, and the team here really knows how to get you back to full function quickly.

I had IASTM and cupping therapy, and the results were clearly noticeable. It helped reduce tightness and pain, and significantly improved my range of motion. I would definitely recommend it to anyone doing CrossFit, staying active, or dealing with injuries or discomfort.

Big thanks to Bhank, who worked with me. He is very knowledgeable and professional, and he takes the time to explain everything so you understand both the issue and the treatment process.

If you are dealing with any kind of injury or ongoing pain, Recovery Room is definitely worth checking out. Highly recommended!
